definition: a long roofed porch along a building
description: On a rainy summer day, a laughing young woman with curly hair, a knotted white shirt and denim shorts roller-skates along the wet floorboards of a long covered wooden porch beside a white house, coming towards the viewer and spreading her arms wide. A ceiling fan turns overhead, ferns hang in baskets, and a white rocking chair, tall shuttered doors and a jug of iced tea on the white railing line the porch. A dog lies on the boards behind her.
